description: This Java source file defines the 'StableArrayAdapter' class, a custom ArrayAdapter for managing a list of Strings in an Android ListView with stable IDs and touch event handling.

classes.name: StableArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter that maintains stable item IDs and attaches a touch listener to list items.

methods.name: StableArrayAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context, layout resource ID, list of objects, and a touch listener; populates the ID map.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the item at the specified position based on the internal ID map.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter has stable item IDs.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Overrides the default view creation to attach a touch listener to each list item view.
